message.content:
The vice-president must also be either the secretary or the treasurer, so exactly one person holds two offices.

- Choose the person who is vice-president and also secretary/treasurer: \(15\) ways.
- Choose whether this person is also secretary or treasurer: \(2\) ways.
- Choose the remaining secretary/treasurer from the remaining members: \(14\) ways.
- Choose the president from the remaining members: \(13\) ways.

So the total number of ways is

\[
15 \times 2 \times 14 \times 13 = 5460.
\]

The answer is 5460.
